question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "out."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Out of which"** is a perfectly acceptable phrase to use in written English.
 
• We can use it when we are referring to a particular group or item, from which something else is being taken.
 
 
• **Example**: *We have five colors to choose from, **out of which**__ two were selected for the design.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 1.
 
• **Correct passage**:

There are over 9000 species of birds on this planet __**out**__ of which over 1360 are found in India alone. 81 species of birds ______ (2) ______endemic to India. Because birds are found everywhere, and in all ______ (3) ______ zones, their sizes, shapes and wings are ______ (4) ______ according to the needs of their habitat. For instance, eagles and hawks have massive soaring wings with primary feather that ______ (5) ______ out and allow them to soar high in the sky.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Some: **a certain amount of or a number of.
 
• **Across: **from one side of something to the other.
 
• **In: **(used to show place) inside or to a position inside a particular area or object.
